title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 037
review_goal: Differentiate five MingCute leaf and butterfly variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Single leaf outline with a curved center vein and a short lower stem
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the simplest natural leaf form with one center vein.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the flower or clover leaf shapes when the single leaf blade matters.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows one leaf blade with a curved inner vein and a short stem below.

items.depicts_observation: Four petal flower outline with one small stem and a center dot
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a small flower shaped nature mark rather than a true leaf blade.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the single leaf or clover form when the four petal blossom matters.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot changes from a leaf blade to a round four petal flower with a center dot.

items.depicts_observation: Four heart shaped leaf loops centered in a clover cross shape
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a clover like four leaf emblem rather than one blade or flower.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the single leaf or flower when the four heart loops are the visual cue.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot arranges four heart shaped loops into a clover style center crossing.

items.depicts_observation: Butterfly outline with two tall wings and a short split antenna tuft
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a butterfly with a narrow body and taller separated wings.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the rounded loop butterfly when the tall wing separation matters.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows tall upright wings divided by a narrow center body and short top tufts.

items.depicts_observation: Butterfly outline with two broad rounded wing loops crossing at the center
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the softer butterfly built from two broad overlapping wing loops.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the tall wing butterfly when the rounded loop wings are the main difference.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot merges the wings into two broad rounded loops that cross at the center.
